text.title: 攻入敌阵
text.objectives: 银色比武场的放血者佐尔比要你在冰冠冰川地区消灭15名诅咒教派成员。你可以在冰冠冰川的任何地方消灭那些异教徒。
text.description: 我们在仿真战中打闹的同时，不能忘了真正的敌人正环伺在我们周围。银色北伐军想通过比赛来选出最好的战士，但是真正的强者只能是那些从战场上生还的人。我们要让那帮圣骑士看看，在为锦标赛做准备的同时，我们也随时准备跟诅咒教派开战。$B$B到冰冠冰川去，杀死你遇到的所有异教徒。他们的力量在奥尔杜萨和亡语者岗哨周围尤其强大。
text.progress: 你有在斗中自我磨练吗？
text.completion: 你证明了我们对抗天灾军团的承诺，不管我们在哪，也不管我们在做什么。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的放血者佐尔比。

english.title: Taking Battle To The Enemy
english.objectives: Zor'be the Bloodletter at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 members of the Cult of the Damned. You may kill cultists in any part of Icecrown.
english.description: While we all play at mock combat, it will do us good to remember that the real enemy surrounds us. The Argent Crusade wants to use competition to find the best fighters, but we can tell that by who returns from battle. Let's show the paladins that we are willing to take battle to the Cult of the Damned, even while making preparations for the tournament.$B$BGo forth into Icecrown and slay any of the cultists you encounter. They have a strong presence around Aldur'thar and Deathspeaker's Watch.
english.progress: Have you tested yourself in combat against the Scourge?
english.completion: You have done well in demonstrating our commitment to fighting the Scourge, no matter where we are or what we are doing.
english.completed: Return to Zor'be the Bloodletter in Icecrown.
english.objective1: Cult of the Damned member slain

text.title: 冠军的比武
text.objectives: 将四枚冠军的印记交给银色比武场的伊尔蕾·夜幕。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在夺日者大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 作为冠军，你已经掌握了骑乘战斗的技巧，击败了各种层次的对手。但你还是要继续练习，确保在锦标赛正式开始之后可以击败所有对手。$B$B你应该继续磨练自己的战斗技巧，了解对手的弱点。代表各个城市参战的冠军都在手兽栏旁的冠军赛场中练习。拿起你的长枪，到兽栏中去骑上属于你的坐骑，面对各位冠军的挑战吧。
text.progress: 你完成了和其他勇士的练习吗？
text.completion: 你对坐骑的操控十分巧妙，$N要不了多久，你的对手就会开始畏惧你。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的伊尔蕾·夜幕。

english.title: Among the Champions
english.objectives: Bring 4 Marks of the Champion to Illyrie Nightfall at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.
english.description: As a champion, you have mastered the art of mounted combat, overcoming challengers of all levels. You must make certain that you can defeat anyone you face when the tournament begins.$B$BYou should continue honing your own skills and learning more about the weaknesses of your opponents. Champions representing all cities practice in the Ring of Champions near the stables. Go to the stables, equip your lance, pick any mount you can ride, then face the champions in practice bouts.
english.progress: Have you finished training with the other champions?
english.completion: You handle your mount well, $N. In time, your competitors will learn to fear you.
english.completed: Return to Illyrie Nightfall in Icecrown.

text.title: 英雄：天文台
text.objectives: 奥杜尔文件馆中的勘探员罗尔伦要你找到天文台的入口。
text.description: 听着，$g小伙子:小姑娘，艾泽拉斯的命运危在旦夕。$B$B我们唯一的机会是到天文台去，找到奥尔加隆，阻止他向他的泰坦主人发送信息。$B$B赶快找到天文台。如果你发现了任何有价值的信息，就立即回来向我报告。奥尔加隆抵达之前，我们还有一些时间可以准备。
text.progress: 你找到它了吗，$N？
text.completion: 锁住了？意料之中！$B$B我会通知布莱恩……或许他能从大数据库里找出点什么。
text.completed: 去找奥杜尔的勘探员罗尔伦。

english.title: Heroic: The Celestial Planetarium
english.objectives: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to locate the entrance to the Celestial Planetarium.
english.description: Listen, $glad:lass;!  Azeroth's fate is at stake here.$B$BOur only chance is to get to the Celestial Planetarium in time to find this Algalon and stop him from beaming back any messages to his Titan masters.$B$BLocate the Celestial Planetarium and come back with any information you get.  We might still have some time to prepare for Algalon's arrival.
english.completion: It's locked?  Figures!$b$bI'll let Brann know... maybe he can uncover something in the Archivum.
english.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

text.title: 英雄：文件馆数据圆盘
text.objectives: 将文件馆数据圆盘带到奥杜尔的文件馆控制台前。
text.description: 这张白金圆盘的表面惊人地光滑匀称，没有一丝的划痕和瑕疵。在这张圆盘的边缘，有一行符文刻成的字：“文件馆”。$B$B奥杜尔内部一定有什么设备可以读入这张圆盘中包含的信息。
text.progress: 当控制台的圆形插座打开时，能量在控制台中呼啸流窜。
text.completion: 白金圆盘完美无缺地勘合进控制台中。它开始旋转而白色的光束扫过圆盘。
text.completed: 去找文件馆控制台。

english.title: Heroic: Archivum Data Disc
english.objectives: Bring the Archivum Data Disc to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
english.description: This platinum disc is surprisingly symmetrical and devoid of any scratches or imperfections.  Engraved along its edge, bold runes spell out the word "ARCHIVUM."$B$BThere must be a device inside Ulduar capable of reading the disc.
english.progress: The console whirrs with energy as the round receptacle opens.
english.completion: The platinum disc fits perfectly inside the console. It begins to spin as its contents are scanned by white beams of light.
english.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

text.title: 英雄：奥尔加隆
text.objectives: 将守护者的徽记带到奥杜尔的文件馆控制台前。
text.description: 你成功了，$N。把这些徽记拿到文件馆的控制台那里去，看看你能否进入天文台。$B$B你最好快一点，$g伙计:小丫头，时间紧迫。
text.progress: 控制台的亮光迅速地扫过玻璃的表面，似乎在等待某些输入。
text.completion: 准备确认。$B$B准许进入星穹浑天仪。请取出你的钥匙。
text.completed: 去找文件馆控制台。

english.title: Heroic: Algalon
english.objectives: Bring the Sigils of the Watchers to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
english.description: You really did it, $N.  Take the sigils to the Archivum Console and see if you can gain access to the Celestial Planetarium.$B$BYou best hurry, $g lad:lass;.  Time is of the essence.
english.progress: The console's bright lights scan the glass surface repeatedly, as if awaiting some form of input.
english.completion: Stand by for verification.$b$bAccess to the Celestial Planetarium granted. Please retrieve your key.
english.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

text.title: 英雄：结果好，一切都好
text.objectives: 将恢复代码阿尔法交给达拉然的罗宁。
text.description: 我们必须抓紧时间，$N。必须回到达拉然，在那里把恢复代码发射出去。$B$B带着它去找罗宁吧，我会在那里等你。
text.progress: 你准备好了吗，$N？
text.completion: 你在这儿。希望这样行得通吧。我们全都靠它了。
text.completed: 去找达拉然的罗宁。

english.title: Heroic: All Is Well That Ends Well
english.objectives: Take the Reply-Code Alpha to Rhonin in Dalaran.
english.description: We'd best hurry now, $N.  We're going to have to transmit the reply-code from Dalaran.$B$BTake it to Rhonin, I will meet you there.
english.progress: You're ready, $N?
english.completion: You're here.  Let us hope this works.  For all our sakes.
english.completed: Return to Rhonin in Crystalsong Forest.

text.title: 布拉斯波兄弟
text.objectives: 与银色比武场的贝兹尔·布拉斯波谈一谈。
text.description: 大领主命令我尽快完成这座体育馆。我们派出了所有的石匠加班加点工作，但很快就发现没有足够的建筑材料。我雇了两个地精来帮忙，也就是贝兹尔·布拉斯波和他的兄弟波兹尔·布拉斯波。$B$B他们负责监督比武场东南本地的工程进度。去和贝兹尔谈谈，看看他们兄弟能不能帮我们找些材料来。
text.progress: 你好。
text.completion: 审判者派你来找我们？很好，很好……$B$B我们总是需要更多的帮手来，呃，“征用”物资。

english.title: The Blastbolt Brothers
english.objectives: Speak with Bezzle Blastbolt at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: The highlord has tasked me with getting that coliseum completed as soon as possible. We've put our own masons to work on the project, but we found out very quickly that we were going to need help procuring materials. I've hired a couple of goblins, Bezzle Blastbolt and his brother, Bozzle.$B$BThey're supervising construction at the southeastern end of the tournament grounds. Speak with Bezzle and see if he and his brother could use any more help getting the building materials we need.
english.completion: So the justicar sent you to see us? Good, good...$b$bWe could always use more help with the, uh, "requisition" of materials.

text.title: 英雄：弗蕾亚的徽记
text.objectives: 将弗蕾亚的徽记交给奥杜尔文件馆中的勘探员罗尔伦。$B$B你可以向文件馆控制台查询如何获得弗蕾亚的徽记。
text.description: 我想弗蕾亚的徽记可能是最难得到的一块。$B$B根据文件馆的数据，徽记与弗蕾亚身边的三位古树仆从密切关联，它们是明叶长老、铁枝长老和石树长老。一旦它们之中有任何一位受到伤害，徽记的完整性就不能保障了。$B$B然而，如果你们对这三位长老手下留情，弗蕾亚的力量就会变得更加强大。$B$B我又能说什么呢，$N，我们现在真是进退维谷。
text.progress: 弗蕾亚的符印，$N？你拿到了吗？
text.completion: 干得漂亮，$N。我们离拯救艾泽拉斯又更近了一步！
text.completed: 去找奥杜尔的勘探员罗尔伦。

english.title: Heroic: Freya's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Freya's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Freya's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Freya's Sigil is going to be one of the tougher ones, I reckon.$B$BAccording to the Archivum, the essence of the Sigil is tied to her three elder servants, Brightleaf, Ironbranch and Stonebark.  Should any of the elders be harmed, the Sigil's integrity will be compromised.$B$BSparing the elders, however, means that Freya will be more powerful when you face her.$B$BWhat can I say, $N.  We're stuck between a rock and hard place.
english.progress: Freya's sigil, $n? Do ye have it?
english.completion: Excellent job, $N. We're one step closer to saving Azeroth!
english.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

text.title: 英雄：霍迪尔的徽记
text.objectives: 将霍迪尔的徽记交给奥杜尔文件馆中的勘探员罗尔伦。$B$B你可以向文件馆控制台查询如何获得霍迪尔的徽记。
text.description: 要拿到霍迪尔的徽记可不容易。你不但要击败霍迪尔，而且必须抢在他打碎装着徽记的箱子之前击败他！$B$B如果你想了解更多信息的话，可以去查查文件馆的控制台。那里面的知识比世界上所有的图书馆加在一起还要多！
text.progress: 你达到符印了吗，$N？
text.completion: 你办到了！我不知道你怎么做到的，但你居然成功了！
text.completed: 去找奥杜尔的勘探员罗尔伦。

english.title: Heroic: Hodir's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Hodir's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Hodir's Sigil, consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Hodir's Sigil won't be easy to obtain.  Not only are ye going to have to defeat Hodir himself, but yer going to have to do it before he destroys the chest that contains it!$B$BCheck the Archivum console if you need more information.  That thing contains more knowledge than all of the world's libraries put together!
english.progress: Did ye obtain the sigil, $n?
english.completion: Ye did it! I don't know how, but ye did!
english.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

text.title: 英雄：托里姆的徽记
text.objectives: 将托里姆的徽记交给奥杜尔文件馆中的勘探员罗尔伦。$B$B你可以向文件馆控制台查询如何获得托里姆的徽记。
text.description: 托里姆已经失去了自我，$N。一股黑暗的力量正在影响着他。$B$B某个邪恶的家伙假扮成他死去的妻子西芙，蒙蔽了他的心智。$B$B你要阻止那个冒牌货控制托里姆。如果托里姆被这股力量征服，我们就永远都不能找到他的徽记了！$B$B你要让他清醒过来，越快越好！$B$B和以往一样，文件馆的控制台会给你提供所有必要的消息……包括那些你不喜欢听到的消息。
text.progress: 嗯，$N？你拿到了吗？
text.completion: 你总是叫人叹为观止，$N。$B$B你跟我一定得在这一切结束之后好好喝一杯，知道吗？
text.completed: 去找奥杜尔的勘探员罗尔伦。

english.title: Heroic: Thorim's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Thorim's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Thorim's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Thorim's not himself, $N.  He's come under a dark influence.$B$BAn evil presence under the guise of an illusion pretends to be his lost wife, Sif.$B$BYe can't let him be overcome by this impostor's spell.  If he does, the location of his sigil might forever be lost!$B$BYer going to have to beat some sense into him and yer going to have to do it quick.$B$BAs always, the Archivum Console will give ye all the gory details... even the ones ye don't like.
english.progress: Well, $n? Do ye have it?
english.completion: Ye never cease to impress, $N.$b$bYe and me are having a pint together after all this is done, ye hear me?
english.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

text.title: 英雄：米米尔隆的徽记
text.objectives: 将米米尔隆的徽记交给奥杜尔文件馆中的勘探员罗尔伦。$B$B你可以向文件馆控制台查询如何获得米米尔隆的徽记。
text.description: 米米尔隆是个聪明的家伙，他给自己的地盘装上了一套自毁设备。$B$B很不幸，如果你想要拿到徽记，就必须争分夺秒。如果你需要了解什么详细的数据，可以去文件馆控制台那里查询。
text.progress: 你拿到符印了吗，$N？
text.completion: 我把它交给你了，$N。我们的机会或许不大，但有你的帮助让我安心很多。
text.completed: 去找奥杜尔的勘探员罗尔伦。

english.title: Heroic: Mimiron's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Loren at the Ulduar Archivum wants you to obtain Mimiron's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Mimiron's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Mimiron's a clever one.  His entire abode is rigged with some sort of self-destruction mechanism.$B$BUnfortunately yer gonna have to race against it if ye want to get his sigil.  Check the Archivum Console for more details if ye need them.
english.progress: Were you able to obtain the sigil, $n?
english.completion: I've got to hand it to you, $N. Our odds might not be the best, but I feel a lot better with you lending a hand.
english.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

text.title: 蚌肉大餐
text.completion: 哈，我记得你！不就是之前帮我做那些蚌肉的$C？$B$B你知道吗，让我给你瞧瞧我最新的食谱——简单又美味！

text.title: 钓鱼专家纳特·帕格
text.completion: 你好啊，年轻的$r。要不就是我记忆力太差，不然就是我忘了给你上次我们提到的……

text.title: 宝藏！
text.progress: 呃啊啊啊啊啊！
text.completion: 你找到它了！
text.completed: 去找海盗的宝箱。

english.title: Treasure!
english.completed: Return to Pirate Treasure Chest.

text.title: 近战训练
text.objectives: 装备上你的长枪，到大帐外面骑上兽栏中的奎尔多雷战马。和耶兰·洛克伍德谈一谈，然后对一个近战目标使用5次刺击。完成训练后回到银色比武场，向奥术师泰利斯复命。
text.description: 锦标赛的核心项目就是骑乘战斗。拿上这杆长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上奎尔多雷战马吧。$B$B骑上战马之后，去跟耶兰·洛克伍德谈一谈。他就在比武场的北部，候选者赛场东面的训练场地里。耶兰会教你学会使用防御技能，在近身战斗中保证自己的安全。
text.progress: 你和耶兰·洛克伍德谈过了吗？练习了近距骑乘战斗？
text.completion: 在你和那些假人训练时，牢记大师的教导。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的奥术师泰利斯。
text.objective2: 对近战目标使用刺击技能

english.title: Mastery Of Melee
english.objectives: Equip your lance, then mount the Stabled Quel'dorei Steed outside the pavilion. Speak to Jeran Lockwood and use Thrust 5 times on a Melee Target, then return to Arcanist Taelis at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: The heart of tournament competition is mounted melee combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Quel'dorei steed just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Jeran Lockwood. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Jeran will instruct you on how to use your defenses to keep you safe while attacking a melee target at close range.
english.progress: Did you speak to Jeran Lockwood and practice close range mounted melee?
english.completion: Keep the words of the master in mind as you practice with the training dummies.
english.completed: Return to Arcanist Taelis in Icecrown.

text.title: 近战训练
text.objectives: 装备上你的长枪，到大帐外面骑上兽栏中的夺日者陆行鸟。和耶兰·洛克伍德谈一谈，然后对一个近战目标使用5次刺击。完成训练后回到银色比武场，向魔导师埃迪恩·炎谷复命。
text.description: 锦标赛的核心项目就是骑乘战斗。拿上这杆长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上夺日者陆行鸟吧。$B$B骑上陆行鸟之后，去跟耶兰·洛克伍德谈一谈。他就在比武场的北部，候选者赛场东面的训练场地里。耶兰会教你学会使用防御技能，在近身战斗中保证自己的安全。
text.progress: 你学会如何利用近战标靶训练了吗？
text.completion: 在你和那些假人训练时，牢记大师的教导。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的魔导师埃迪恩·炎谷。
text.objective2: 对近战目标使用刺击技能

english.title: Mastery Of Melee
english.objectives: Equip your lance, then mount the Stabled Sunreaver Hawkstrider outside the pavilion. Speak to Jeran Lockwood and use Thrust 5 times on a Melee Target, then return to Magister Edien Sunhollow at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: The heart of tournament competition is mounted melee combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Sunreaver hawkstrider just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Jeran Lockwood. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Jeran will instruct you on how to use your defenses to keep you safe while attacking a melee target at close range.
english.progress: Did you speak to Jeran Lockwood and practice close range mounted melee?
english.completion: Keep the words of the master in mind as you practice with the training dummies.
english.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 幽灵鱼
text.objectives: 达拉然城中的玛西娅·切斯希望你去揭开幽灵鱼的秘密。
text.description: 在诺森德垂钓的人如果没有听说过亚口鱼，那可真是白活了。这种鱼不能食用，但在炼金领域里有特殊的用途。$B$B不过，在索拉查盆地的河流之心一带生活的亚口鱼群中，隐藏着另一种鱼类：幽灵鱼。只要一离开水，这种鱼就会逐渐变得透明，最后完全消失。有些人猜测它回到了索拉查盆地，而其它人的猜测就更加不着边际了……$B$B总之，我希望你去想办法找到这种鱼，揭开它的秘密！
text.progress: 你发现了幽灵鱼的秘密了吗？$B$B<玛西娅目不转睛地盯着你。>
text.completion: 所以吃下它会让你变透明……这种聪明的鱼奇特的防卫机制终于被解开了。$B$B我得稍微的消化消化。这可不是双关语，$N，真的。或许你可以明天再来找我？
text.completed: 去找达拉然的玛西娅·切斯。

english.title: The Ghostfish
english.objectives: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to discover the mystery of the Phantom Ghostfish.
english.description: Any Northrend angler worth $ghis:her; salt knows about the pygmy suckerfish.  It's not edible, but sometimes useful to alchemists.$b$bThere is, however, a stealthy fish that hides among the suckerfish in the River's Heart of Sholazar Basin.  The phantom ghostfish.  When out of water, they become increasingly translucent until they fade away completely.  Some hypothesize they return to Sholazar, and others are more... superstitious.$b$bI want you to catch this fish and discover its secret by any means!
english.progress: Is the ghostfish haunting your best efforts?$b$b<Marcia looks particularly proud of herself for her pun.>
english.completion: So eating it makes you invisible... what a strange defense this clever fish has developed.$b$bI'd like to digest this for a bit. Pun not intended, $N. Really. Why don't you come see me tomorrow?
english.completed: Return to Marcia Chase in Dalaran.

text.title: 下水道中的珍宝
text.objectives: 将一块被腐蚀的珠宝交给达拉然城中的玛西娅·切斯。
text.description: 我真不敢相信，有那么多人去达拉然下水道钓鱼，只为几只大老鼠或是变异鱼。难道他们不知道，有许多伤心欲绝的傻子、走投无路的窃贼和心不在焉的醉汉，把数不清的无价之宝扔到了下水道里吗？$B$B在那里钓鱼的秘诀是把鱼钩沉到水底去，如果钓到了什么东西，就缓缓地把线收上来。去试试吧，$N，我会用我收藏的宝贝和你钓上来的东西交换的。
text.progress: 运气如何？
text.completion: 很好，这看起来挺有价值的。但是在清理完毕和估价前很难知道值多少，不过我还是愿意跟你交易。
text.completed: 去达拉然找玛西娅·切斯。

english.title: Jewel Of The Sewers
english.objectives: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to bring her a piece of Corroded Jewelry.
english.description: Hard to believe that most people fish in the Dalaran Sewers for giant rats and mutated fish.  Especially when those waters are filled with priceless jewelry - discarded by broken hearted fools, thieves, and careless drunks.$b$bThe trick is to let your hook drag the bottom and don't pull up too hard when you get something.  Try it out, $N.  I'd be willing to trade whatever you find for a few trinkets of my own.
english.progress: Any luck?
english.completion: Well now, that looks like it could be valuable. Difficult to know until it's cleaned up and appraised, but I'm still willing to make the trade if you are.
english.completed: Return to Marcia Chase at Forlorn Woods in Crystalsong Forest.

text.title: 血腥的美食
text.objectives: 达拉然城中的玛西娅·切斯希望你为她带去5条血齿狂鱼。
text.description:
血齿狂鱼可以用来烹制一道佳肴，对治愈感染伤口有奇效。如果你有兴趣的话，我们能让它们能派上一些用场。

就如同它们的名字所暗示的，血齿狂鱼会被鲜血的味道所吸引。据我所知，想要钓起这些小恶鱼就只有一种办法：弄出一片带血的池塘来。

先把你自己弄得满身是血——只需要在北风苔原杀掉几头动物——然后跳进水里就行。如此一来，溶入了鲜血的池塘就成了绝佳的渔点。
text.progress: 钓到血齿狂鱼了吗？别忘了我教你的制造血池的办法。
text.completion: 你很勇敢，$N。我希望你没有为了弄出钓渔点而受到什么损伤。如果你还热衷于钓鱼的话，明天来找我，我们可以再聊聊。
text.completed: 去达拉然找玛西娅·切斯。

english.title: Blood Is Thicker
english.objectives: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to bring her 5 Bloodtooth Frenzies.
english.description: The bloodtooth is a feisty little fish used in a recipe to cure infected wounds.  We could use some of them, if you're up to it.$b$bAs the name suggests, they've a hunger for blood.  The only way I know how to catch the little devils is by creating a blood pool and fishing in it.$b$bGet yourself covered in blood - just slaughter a beast in the Borean Tundra - and then jump in the water.  It'll wash right off and create the perfect fishing spot.
english.progress: Any luck with the bloodtooth?  Don't forget what I told you about making blood pools.
english.completion: You are a brave one, $N.  I hope you didn't lose any extremities making your fishing spot.  If you've still got the fishing bug, come back tomorrow and we'll talk some more.
english.completed: Return to Marcia Chase at Forlorn Woods in Crystalsong Forest.

text.title: 危险的美食
text.objectives: 将10条恐怖鱼交给达拉然城中的玛西娅·切斯。
text.description: 最好的钓鱼地点总是最危险的。冬拥湖里有无数的战利品等待着大胆的垂钓者。$B$B事实上，只有在冬拥湖才能钓到传说中最危险也最美味的恐怖鱼。给我带些这种鱼来，然后我们再好好聊聊。
text.progress: 在你追踪恐怖鱼时要小心戒备。
text.completion: 喔喔喔！你抓到恐怖鱼了。唉，这可让我想起过去……$B$B<玛西娅开始叨絮大串的冒险与钓鱼故事，似乎只要你愿意听，她就能没完没了地讲下去。>
text.completed: 去达拉然找玛西娅·切斯。

english.title: Dangerously Delicious
english.objectives: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to bring her 10 Terrorfish.
english.description: The best fishing is often the most dangerous.  Wintergrasp boasts a bountiful catch for the brazen.$b$bIn fact, it's the only place to catch the fabled Terrorfish - a fish both lethal and delicious.  Bring me some, and we'll have something to discuss.
english.progress: Be on your guard when you're after the Terrorfish.
english.completion: My, my, my! You've caught yourself some Terrorfish. Why, that reminds me of the time...$b$b<Marcia regales you with stories of adventure and fishing for as long as you're willing to listen.>
english.completed: Return to Marcia Chase at Forlorn Woods in Crystalsong Forest.

text.title: 碎盾训练
text.objectives: 装备上你的长枪，到大帐外面骑上兽栏中的奎尔多雷战马。和瓦利斯·逐风者谈一谈，然后对两个脆弱的远程目标使用碎盾技能。完成训练后回到银色比武场，向斥候沙琳蒂亚复命。
text.description: 想要在骑乘战斗中获得胜利，你就必须先学会如何突破对手的防御。拿上这杆长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上奎尔多雷战马吧。$B$B骑上战马以后，去找瓦利斯·逐风者谈一谈。他就在比武场的北部，候选者赛场东面的训练场地里。瓦利斯会向你传授使用远程武器击破对手盾牌的基础技巧，这样就可以更容易地击败你的目标。
text.progress: 你练习使用破盾了吗？
text.completion: 牢牢记住瓦利斯的课程，$N。这决定了你会赢得比赛还是在战斗中摔下坐骑。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的斥候沙琳蒂亚。
text.objective2: 对脆弱的远程目标使用碎盾技能

english.title: Mastery Of The Shield-Breaker
english.objectives: Equip your lance and mount the Stabled Quel'dorei Steed outside the pavilion. Speak to Valis Windchaser and use Shield-Breaker on 2 vulnerable Ranged Targets, then return to Scout Shalyndria at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: You'll need to learn how to break through an opponent's defenses to succeed in mounted combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Quel'dorei steed just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Valis Windchaser. He'll be on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Valis will teach you the basics of using a ranged shield breaker attack to make a ranged target vulnerable.
english.progress: Have you practiced using your shield-breaker?
english.completion: Commit Valis's lesson to memory, $N. It will mean the difference between winning and losing your mounted combat matches.
english.completed: Return to Scout Shalyndria in Icecrown.
english.objective2: Use Shield-Breaker on vulnerable Ranged Target

text.title: 胳膊丢了！
text.objectives: 将断臂交给达拉然城中的善良的欧莉萨拉。
text.description: 我得到消息，在达拉然监狱发生了一桩非常不幸的意外。一名卫兵的胳膊被一个邪恶的囚犯砍断，又被扔进了水里。$b$b我们的急救医生说，如果能找回那条胳膊，他们就能为那名卫兵接好断肢。$b$b你在那座监狱外面的水域去垂钓一下。我用我最好的鱼竿打赌，只要你用的时间足够长，就一定能找到那条胳膊。然后你把它带回达拉然来，交给善良的欧莉萨拉。她知道该怎么做。
text.progress: 你好啊，你有什么东西要带给我吗？
text.completion: 喔，你好啊，$N。玛西娅说你会把那个可怜人遗失的手臂给找回来。$B$B她也把这个袋子交给我，做为一种奖励。它闻起来真糟糕，如果你不在意的话我想快点交给你。
text.completed: 去达拉然城的急你所急找善良的欧莉萨拉。

english.title: Disarmed!
english.objectives: Olisarra the Kind in Dalaran City wants you to return the Severed Arm to her.
english.description: I've received word of an unfortunate accident at the Dalaran prison; a guard had his arm severed and thrown into the water by a particularly vicious inmate.$b$bOur first aid clinic promises they can reattach the arm if we bring it back.$b$bYou fish long enough in the water outside the prison, and I'd bet my favorite fishing pole that arm will surface.  Find that arm, and bring it to Olisarra the Kind here in Dalaran.  She'll know what to do.
english.progress: Hi there.  Do you have something for me?
english.completion: Oh, hello there $N.  Marcia said you'd be coming by with that poor man's missing arm.$b$bShe also gave me this bag to give you as a reward.  It smells horrible, and I'm anxious to make the trade if you don't mind.
english.completed: Return to Olisarra the Kind at First to Your Aid in Dalaran City.

text.title: 冲锋训练
text.objectives: 装备上你的长枪，到大帐外面骑上兽栏中的奎尔多雷战马。和卢格安·钢胃谈一谈，然后向两个脆弱的冲锋目标发动冲锋。完成训练后回到银色比武场，向阿瓦雷斯·迅击复命。
text.description: 在骑乘战斗中，冲锋是最强大的攻击方式。拿上这杆长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上奎尔多雷战马吧。$B$B骑上战马之后，去和卢格安·钢胃谈一谈。他就在比武场的北部，候选者赛场东面的训练场地里。卢格安会告诉你如何使用这项强大的技能，还会教你一些其它的基本战术。
text.progress: 你精通于冲锋的使用了吗？
text.completion: 有了阿瓦雷斯这样的老师，你很快就会成为骑乘战斗的专家。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的阿瓦雷斯·迅击。
text.objective2: 向脆弱的冲锋目标发动冲锋

english.title: Mastery Of The Charge
english.objectives: Equip your lance and mount the Stabled Quel'dorei Steed outside the pavilion. Speak to Rugan Steelbelly and Charge 2 vulnerable Charge Targets, then return to Avareth Swiftstrike at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Your strongest attack in mounted combat is undoubtedly the charge. Take this lance and mount the stabled Quel'dorei steed just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, speak with Rugan Steelbelly. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Rugan will tell you how to use this powerful ability and teach you some basic strategies.
english.progress: Have you mastered the use of the charge?
english.completion: With a teacher like Rugan, you'll be an expert at mounted combat in no time.
english.completed: Return to Avareth Swiftstrike in Icecrown.

text.title: 碎盾训练
text.objectives: 装备上你的长枪，到大帐外面骑上兽栏中的夺日者陆行鸟。和瓦利斯·逐风者谈一谈，然后对两个脆弱的远程目标使用碎盾技能。完成训练后回到银色比武场，向加拉希亚·晨光复命。
text.description: 想要在骑乘战斗中获得胜利，你就必须先学会如何突破对手的防御。拿上这杆长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上夺日者陆行鸟吧。$B$B骑上陆行鸟以后，去找瓦利斯·逐风者谈一谈。他就在比武场的北部，候选者赛场东面的训练场地里。瓦利斯会向你传授使用远程武器击破对手盾牌的基础技巧，这样就可以更容易地击败你的目标。
text.progress: 你完成了破盾的训练吗？
text.completion: 牢牢记住瓦利斯的课程，$N。这决定了你会赢得比赛还是在战斗中摔下坐骑。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的加拉希亚·晨光。
text.objective2: 对脆弱的远程目标使用碎盾技能

english.title: Mastery Of The Shield-Breaker
english.objectives: Equip your lance and mount the Stabled Sunreaver Hawkstrider. Speak to Valis Windchaser and use Shield-Breaker on 2 vulnerable Ranged Targets, then return to Galathia Brightdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: You'll need to learn how to break through an opponent's defenses to succeed in mounted combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Sunreaver hawkstrider just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Valis Windchaser. He'll be on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Valis will teach you the basics of using a ranged shield breaker attack to make a ranged target vulnerable.
english.progress: Have you practiced using your shield-breaker?
english.completion: Commit Valis's lesson to memory, $N. It will mean the difference between winning and losing your mounted combat matches.
english.completed: Return to Galathia Brightdawn at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.
english.objective2: Use Shield-Breaker on vulnerable Ranged Target

text.title: 冲锋训练
text.objectives: 装备上你的长枪，到大帐外面骑上兽栏中的夺日者陆行鸟。和卢格安·钢胃谈一谈，然后向两个脆弱的冲锋目标发动冲锋。完成训练后回到银色比武场，向阿玛里尔·火盟复命。
text.description: 在骑乘战斗中，冲锋是最强大的攻击方式。拿上这杆长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上夺日者陆行鸟吧。$B$B骑上陆行鸟之后，去和卢格安·钢胃谈一谈。他就在比武场的北部，候选者赛场东面的训练场地里。卢格安会告诉你如何使用这项强大的技能，还会教你一些其它的基本战术。
text.progress: 你精通于冲锋的使用了吗？
text.completion: 通过经验与练习，你可以让你的冲锋非常致命。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的阿玛里尔·火盟。
text.objective2: 向脆弱的冲锋目标发动冲锋

english.title: Mastery Of The Charge
english.objectives: Equip your lance and mount the Stabled Sunreaver Hawkstrider outside the pavilion. Speak to Rugan Steelbelly and Charge 2 vulnerable Charge Targets, then return to Amariel Sunsworn at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Your strongest attack in mounted combat is undoubtedly the charge. Take this lance and mount the stabled Sunreaver hawkstrider just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, speak with Rugan Steelbelly. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Rugan will tell you how to use this powerful ability and teach you some basic strategies.
english.completion: With experience and practice, you will become deadly with the charge.
english.completed: Return to Amariel Sunsworn at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 重复使用
text.objectives: 找一些特殊的鸡饲料，把它交给友好的小鸡。当你找到小鸡的时候，在喂食它特殊的鸡饲料之前对它做出拍动翅膀的表情。
text.description: 「咕咕嘎...咕咕嘎...咕咕!$B$B咕咕嘎...咕咕嘎...咕咕。」$B$B小雞抬頭看著你，然後伸出爪子探到地面上。你認為它是在拼寫某個單字，但是又不確定是什麼單字...難道是指薩丁農場嗎?在你發出詢問之前，小雞轉過身子，做它自己的事兒去了。
text.progress: 小鸡用它那双黑暗而凌厉的眼神盯着你，等着你给它喂食。$B$B“咕咕嘎！$B$B咕咕……咕咕……咕咕。”
text.completion: “咕咕嘎！”$B$B小鸡开始狼吞虎咽地啄食你丢给它的食物。$B$B不一会儿，小鸡开始注视四周，有些受惊的样子。它来回地跺着步，显得极为不适。难道这只小鸡要下蛋了吗？你认为最好检查一下它的身下。
text.completed: 去找鸡。

english.title: REUSE
english.objectives: Find some Special Chicken Feed and return to your befriended chicken. When you find it,/cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed.
english.description: "Cluck... cluck... cluck... BACAW!$B$BCluck... cluck... cluck."$B$BThe chicken looks up at you and then starts to scratch its claws into the ground. You think it is spelling out a word,but you are not sure what it is. Could it be... S-A-L-D-E-A-N? Before you can ask,the chicken turns away and goes about its business.
english.completed: Return to Chicken.

text.title: 废物贩卖机器人制造器
text.objectives: 使用创世者的图书馆中的原型机控制台。
text.description: 在数据库中搜索了一番之后，你找到了一张有关废物贩卖机器人制造器的结构图。正好你自己也是工程学方面的专家，因此你可以学习这张结构图，以备将来制造自己的废物贩卖机器人制造器。
text.progress: 原型控制台看来连上线了。
text.completion: 你抄下了图样中的数据还有制造废料机器人组装包所需要的材料。

english.title: The Scrapbot Construction Kit
english.objectives: Interact with the Prototype Console in The Inventor's Library.
english.description: Searching the databanks of the prototype console reveals schematics for a scrapbot construction kit. With your engineering expertise, you could learn this schematic and produce scrapbot construction kits of your own.
english.completion: You take note of the information displayed in the schematic and the materials required to construct the scrapbot kit.

text.title: 密封的毒药瓶
text.objectives: 将密封的毒药瓶交给达拉然下水道的炼金师辛奈斯拉。
text.description: 这只装着毒药的小瓶子看上去很危险。也许达拉然城中的某人会对它感兴趣。
text.progress: 那是我所认为的东西吗，$C？
text.completion: 把这东西带过来的你真是勇敢。只要这东西摔破并碰到你的皮肤，你就会在痛苦中死去。$B$B让我买下它……我能够让毒药发挥意料之外的效果。
text.completed: 去达拉然找黑市的炼金师辛奈斯拉。

english.title: Sealed Vial of Poison
english.objectives: Bring the Seal Vial of Poison to Alchemist Cinesra in the Dalaran Sewers.
english.description: This vial of poison looks particularly dangerous.  Perhaps someone in Dalaran might be interested in it.
english.progress: Is that what I think it is, $c?
english.completion: You are brave to have carried this.  If even one drop were to touch your skin, you'd have died an agonizing death.$b$bAllow me to pay you for it... I can always use venom of exceptional potency.
english.completed: Return to Alchemist Cinesra at the Black Market in Dalaran.

text.title: 微薄的贡献
text.objectives: 与侍从亚迪再次交谈，为银色北伐军的事业捐献10枚金币。
text.description: 最优秀的冠军们每天都来礼拜堂，聆听银色神官的演讲。$B$B你应该看看她给予了这些人多大的鼓舞，$N。他们不仅坚定了为银色北伐军作战的信心，还向我的捐赠篮中放入了大把的金币。$B$B你要不要也捐赠一点？
text.progress: 你想要捐款吗？
text.completion: 谢谢你。北伐军会好好运用这笔钱的！

english.title: Contributin' To The Cause
english.objectives: Speak with Squire Artie to contribute 10 gold to the Argent Crusade's cause.
english.description: The bestest of the champions come to the chapel to hear the argent confessor speak every day.$B$BYou should see how much she inspires them, $N. Not only do they fight for the Argent Crusade, but they put a lot of money into the collection basket when I take it around.$B$BMaybe you'd like to contribute too?
english.progress: Do you want to contribute?
english.completion: Thank you. I just know the crusade will put it to good use!

text.title: 兵临城下
text.objectives: 银色比武场的约瑟夫·霍雷上尉要求你消灭15名白骨卫士步兵、10名白骨卫士斥候和3名白骨卫士军官。
text.description: 在我们准备锦标赛的同时，银色北伐军也在准备对敌人的冰冠堡垒发动攻击。$B$B在冰冠冰川西南部的白骨之庭，几位勇敢的北伐军战士已经在恐惧之门科雷萨以南创建了先头营地。拿上你的长枪到营地去，骑上军马，击败巫妖王的仆从吧。$B$B你会遇到许多的白骨卫士步兵，不过你完全不用害怕。你的战马可以轻易地将它们踏平。
text.progress: 你和白骨之廷的北伐军并肩作战了吗？
text.completion: 你在战场上的英勇已经向北伐军证明了一件众所皆知的事——我们的战士绝不仅只是节庆游行的装饰品而已。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的约瑟夫·霍雷上尉。

english.title: At The Enemy's Gates
english.objectives: Captain Joseph Holley at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 Boneguard Footmen, 10 Boneguard Scouts, and 3 Boneguard Lieutenants.
english.description: Even as we ready for the tournament, Argent Crusade forces prepare the way for an assault on the enemy's stronghold of Icecrown Citadel.$B$BIn the Court of Bones in southwestern Icecrown, a few brave crusaders have set up a forward camp on the southern side of Corp'rethar. Equip your lance and mount the stabled campaign charger at the camp, then destroy the Lich King's minions.$B$BDo not fear the masses of boneguard footmen, $N, for they can easily be trampled under your horse's hooves.
english.progress: Have served alongside the crusaders in the Court of Bones?
english.completion: Your bravery on the field has shown the crusaders what they already knew -- that our warriors are more than just parade ground decorations.
english.completed: Return to Captain Joseph Holley in Icecrown.

text.title: 毒药的免疫力
text.objectives: 安戈洛环形山的莫维克说，如果你能被毒皮暴掠龙的血染上20次毒，就可以安全地骑它了。攻击毒皮魔暴龙，有一定几率会中毒。
text.description: 你想骑毒皮暴掠龙吗？恐怕我有些坏消息要告诉你。$B$B毒皮暴掠龙全身都是毒，从血液到唾沫，连皮肤表面都有毒素。你要是爬上去，不出几个小时就会中毒而死。$B$B在我卖给你毒皮龙之前，你必须先获得抵抗毒素的能力，这要花很长的时间，非常长……你需要去在战斗中沐浴毒血，要洗许多次。如果你真的对此感兴趣，那么你要知道，毒皮暴掠龙经常会出现在沼泽地的北部本地，你一直向西北方走，就能找到那里了。
text.progress: 还没免疫？放弃吧。那太累了！
text.completion: 你做到了？你真的做到了？！$B$B喔呵！你跟我太太一样固执。
text.completed: 去安戈洛环形山找沼泽地的莫维克。

english.title: Toxic Tolerance
english.objectives: Mor'vek in Un'goro Crater claims that if you were poisoned by Venomhide Ravasaur blood 20 times, you could ride one without dying. Attack Venomhide Ravasaurs for a chance to be poisoned.
english.description: You want to ride a Venomhide? Then I've got bad news for you.$B$BThe Venomhide Ravasaurs, they're all poison: Poison blood, poison spit, poison skin. You climb on one, you fall off dead in a few hours.$B$BYou'd have to build up a resistance to their toxins before I sold you one, and that takes a long, LONG time... you'd need to be splashed with poisonous blood while fighting one numerous times. If you're really interested, the venomhides prefer the northern area of of the Marshlands, northwest of here.
english.progress: Still not immune, eh? Give up. It takes too long!
english.completion: You did it? You actually did it?!$b$bHo ho! Stubborn as my wife, you are.
english.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 堡垒外的战斗
text.objectives: 银色比武场的纯洁者耶德瑞克要求你消灭3名白骨卫士指挥官。
text.description: 在我们为锦标赛做准备工作的时候，我们的兄弟已经准备向敌人的冰冠堡垒发动进攻了。$B$B在冰冠冰川西南部的白骨之庭，几位勇敢的十字军战士已经在恐惧之门科雷萨以南创建了先头营地。拿上你的长枪，骑上军马，到那座营地去击败巫妖王的仆从吧。$B$B你会遇到许多的白骨卫士步兵，不过你完全不用害怕。你的战马可以轻易地将它们踏平。
text.progress: 你对抗白骨之廷的敌人了吗？
text.completion: 在对抗巫妖王的战斗中有你这样的$C和我们一起并肩作战激励了银色北伐军。
text.completed: 转至冰冠冰川，去找银色比武场的纯洁者耶德瑞克。

english.title: Battle Before The Citadel
english.objectives: Eadric the Pure at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 3 Boneguard Commanders.
english.description: Even as some of us labor on the tournament, our brothers prepare the way for an assault on the enemy's stronghold of Icecrown Citadel.$B$BIn the Court of Bones in southwestern Icecrown, a few brave crusaders have set up a forward camp on the southern side of Corp'rethar. Equip your lance and mount the stabled campaign charger at the camp, then destroy the Lich King's commanders.$B$BDo not fear the masses of boneguard footmen, $N, for they can easily be trampled under your horse's hooves.
english.progress: Have you fought against the enemy in the Court of Bones?
english.completion: The Argent Crusade is heartened to have $cs like you fighting alongside us in the battle against the Lich King.
english.completed: Return to Eadric the Pure at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.completed: 转至冰冠冰川，去找银色比武场的纯洁者耶德瑞克。

english.completion: The Argent Crusade is heartened to have $cs like you fighting alongside us in the battle against the Lich King.
english.completed: Return to Eadric the Pure at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 堡垒外的战斗
text.objectives: 银色比武场的科罗克·斩亡者要求你消灭3名白骨卫士指挥官。
text.description: 十字军的一部分成员正为锦标赛做准备工作，而另外一些十字军已经准备向敌人的冰冠堡垒发动进攻了。$B$B在冰冠冰川西南部的白骨之庭，几位勇敢的十字军战士已经在恐惧之门科雷萨以南创建了先头营地。拿起长枪，骑上战马，到营地去击败巫妖王的仆从吧。$B$B你会遇到许多的白骨卫士步兵，$N不过你完全不用害怕。你的战马可以轻易地将它们踏平。
text.progress: 你对抗白骨之廷的敌人了吗？
text.completion: 无论在何处遇见天灾军团，我们都使他们感到畏惧，此战也不例外。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的科罗克·斩亡者。

english.title: Battle Before The Citadel
english.objectives: Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 3 Boneguard Commanders.
english.description: As some crusaders prepare for the tournament, they have sent others to make an assault on the enemy's stronghold of Icecrown Citadel.$B$BIn the Court of Bones in southwestern Icecrown, a few brave crusaders have set up a forward camp on the southern side of Corp'rethar. Equip your lance and mount the stabled campaign charger at the camp, then destroy the Lich King's commanders.$B$BDo not fear the masses of boneguard footmen, $N, for they can easily be trampled under your horse's hooves.
english.progress: Have you fought against the enemy in the Court of Bones?
english.completion: Everywhere we have met the Scourge, we have made them fear us, and this campaign is no different.
english.completed: Return to Crok Scourgebane in Icecrown.

text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的科罗克·斩亡者。

english.progress: Have you fought against the enemy in the Court of Bones?
english.completion: Everywhere we have fought the Scourge, we have taught them to fear us and this campaign will be no different.
english.completed: Return to Crok Scourgebane in Icecrown.

text.title: 毒皮暴掠龙蛋
text.objectives: 把4枚毒皮暴掠龙蛋带给位于沼泽地东南的莫维克。
text.description: 现在你对毒皮暴掠龙的毒素已经有了免疫力，可以安全地对付这种猛兽和它们的蛋了。毒皮暴掠龙极为凶猛。如果要驯化它们，就必须从它们刚出生时开始。$B$B如果你想要骑上一头毒皮暴掠龙，你就需要先找到一颗尚未孵化的毒皮暴掠龙蛋。在沼泽地各处分布着一些暴掠龙巢。你应该在那些巢里寻找颜色较浅的龙蛋。那些才是能孵化出毒皮暴掠龙的蛋。$B$B如果你能带给我几颗那种蛋。我会让你自己保留一颗，并指导你用它孵化出毒皮暴掠龙崽。
text.progress: 你找到那些蛋了吗？
text.completion: 做得好。老实说我有点讶异，你竟然能找到这么多颗蛋，因为每窝蛋的数量并不多。$B$B我会让你抚养一只刚孵出来的毒皮暴掠龙。它可不会客气的对你提出它的需求。
text.completed: 去安戈洛环形山找沼泽地的莫维克。

english.title: Venomhide Eggs
english.objectives: Bring 4 Venomhide Ravasaur Eggs to Mor'vek in the southeast part of the Marshlands.
english.description: Now that you've built up an immunity to venomhide toxin, you can safely handle the animals and their eggs. Venomhides are vicious and must be trained from the moment they hatch.$B$BIf you want to ride one, you'll need an unhatched egg. Scattered throughout the Marshlands are a number of ravasaur nests. Look for the eggs with lighter colored shells -- those are the ones that will hatch venomhides.$B$BIf you bring me several of the eggs, I'll allow you to keep one and raise its hatchling, with my guidance.
english.progress: Did you find those eggs?
english.completion: Good work. Honestly, I'm amazed you were able to find this many. With each clutch, they seem fewer in number.$b$bI'll let you raise one of the freshly-hatched venomhides. It shouldn't be shy about letting you know what it needs.
english.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 饥饿的小龙
text.objectives: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你喂它15片鲜嫩的恐龙肉。
text.description: 这只毒皮暴掠龙幼崽用期待的眼神看着你，然后又在土地上画出了一些图案。$B$B这些图案都很粗糙，不过你还是能依稀从里面看出双帆龙，剑龙和翼手龙的形象。这只龙崽画完之后，又向你抬起了头，还露出了牙齿，做了一个咬的动作。$B$B你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽一定是想要吃这些恐龙的肉了。你要在安戈洛环形山找到并猎杀这些双帆龙、剑龙和翼手龙，取得恐龙肉，喂饱你饥饿的龙崽。
text.progress: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽舔了舔嘴唇并将头偏向一边。
text.completion: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽似乎很满足你提供的大餐，但不知道何时它又会饿。
text.completed: 去找毒皮暴掠幼龙。
text.objective1: 喂毒皮暴掠龙幼崽吃鲜嫩的恐龙肉。

english.title: Hungry, Hungry Hatchling
english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 15 pieces of Fresh Dinosaur Meat.
english.description: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe drawings are rough, but you can make out the shapes of diemetradons, stegodons, and pterrordaxes. As the raptor finishes the sketch, it looks up at you, bares its teeth, and makes a biting motion.$B$BYour venomhide hatchling must be craving fresh meat from these animals. Find and kill any type of diematradon, stegodon, or pterrordax in Un'Goro Crater and feed its meat to your hungry hatchling.
english.progress: The hatchling cocks its head and looks at you.
english.completion: The venomhide hatchling seems satisfied with the giant meal you've provided, but there's no way of telling when it will be hungry again.
english.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
english.objective1: Fresh Dinosaur Meat fed to Venomhide Hatchling

text.title: 格里什幼虫
text.objectives: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你喂它10块异种蝎肉。
text.description: 这只毒皮暴掠龙幼崽用期待的眼神看着你，然后又在土地上画出了一些图案。$B$B这些图案所表现的似乎是一些大型昆虫，一些格里什异种蝎。龙崽画完以后，就用前臂指指图画，凭空猛咬了一口，又舔舔嘴唇。$B$B它一定是想让你去位于安戈洛环形山南部中心处的巨痕谷，在那里收集一些异种蝎肉。得到异种蝎肉之后，就用它来喂养你饥饿的龙崽吧。
text.progress: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽歪着头看着你。
text.completion: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽对着你露齿微笑并开始休憩打盹。
text.completed: 去找毒皮暴掠幼龙。
text.objective1: 喂毒皮暴掠龙幼崽吃异种蝎肉。

english.title: Gorishi Grub
english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 10 Silithid Meat.
english.description: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe hatchling's drawings seem to resemble various types of large insects, perhaps the gorishi silithids. The hatchling finishes his picture, then gestures at it with one short arm, snaps its jaws, and licks its lips.$B$BIt must want you to go to the Slithering Scar, in center of the southern part of Un'Goro Crater, and gather silithid meat. When you have the meat, feed it to your hungry hatchling.
english.progress: The hatchling cocks its head and looks at you.
english.completion: Your venomhide hatchling flashes you a toothy smile and then settles in for a nap.
english.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
english.objective1: Silithid Meat fed to Venomhide Hatchling

text.title: 水煮、爆炒还是生吃？
text.objectives: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你喂它12枚异种蝎卵。
text.description: 这只毒皮暴掠龙崽的肚皮发出“咕咕”的响声。它挥舞胳膊，引起了你的注意。然后它在土地上画出一些异种蝎，又在蝎子下面画了一些小的椭圆形。$B$B那一定是异种蝎的卵。你可以到位于塔纳利斯西部，靠近安戈洛环形山边界的腐化之巢去。那里可是一个收集异种蝎卵的好地方。
text.progress: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽看着你。
text.completion: 在吞完异种虫蛋大餐后，你的暴掠龙幼崽舔了舔它的嘴唇。有一瞬间，你觉得它似乎对已经结束的用餐时间感到失望。
text.completed: 去找毒皮暴掠幼龙。
text.objective1: 喂毒皮暴掠龙幼崽吃异种蝎卵。

english.title: Poached, Scrambled, Or Raw?
english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 12 Silithid Eggs.
english.description: The venomhide hatchling's stomach growls as it gestures to get your attention. It begins scratching pictures of silithids into the dirt, adding small ovals underneath them. It looks at you hopefully and gestures at the circles.$B$BThey can only mean silithid eggs. The Noxious Lair, in western Tanaris and near the border with Un'Goro Crater, would probably be a great place to find the eggs your little hatchling wants.
english.progress: The hatchling looks at you.
english.completion: Your hatchling licks its lips after devouring the meal of silithid eggs. For a moment, you think it seems disappointed that feeding time has come to an end.
english.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
english.objective1: Silithid Eggs fed to Venomhide Hatchling

text.title: 炎鹏的羽毛
text.objectives: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你给它弄来5根炎鹏的羽毛。
text.description: 这只幼崽一直在看着你，仿佛正在考虑你是否能明白它的意思。它在土地上用爪子画出两根羽毛的图案，然后又指了指绑在它臂肘和膝盖上的东西。$B$B它看上去并不饿，那么它要羽毛干什么？$B$B它一定是想用羽毛做装饰，就像你在其它暴掠龙身上见到过的那样。炎鹏身上的羽毛是所有羽毛之中最大的。这种猛禽生活在塔纳利斯西部，灌木谷的东北方。它们总喜欢聚集在巨大野兽的尸骨周围。
text.progress: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽期待地看着你。
text.completion: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽收下这些羽毛，开始打量着它们，并且把羽毛装饰在它的臂环上。
text.completed: 去找毒皮暴掠幼龙。

english.title: Searing Roc Feathers
english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to get 5 pieces of Searing Roc Plumage.
english.description: The hatchling looks at you for a moment, almost as if wondering whether you'll understand. It scrawls a picture of a pair of feathers in the dirt, then points with one claw to the bindings at its elbows and knees.$B$BIt doesn't seem hungry, but what could the feathers be for?$B$BIt must want them for adornments like the ones you've seen on other raptors. The largest feathers come from the searing rocs that congregate around the bones of large creatures in western Tanaris, northeast of Thistleshrub Valley.
english.progress: Your venomhide hatchling looks at you with anticipation.
english.completion: The venomhide hatchling accepts the feathers and begins looking them over, holding several up to its armbands.
english.completed: Return to Venomhide Hatchling.

text.title: 飞速成长
text.objectives: 将20枚毒皮暴掠幼龙牙齿、你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽，还有20块符文布、20块硬甲皮和80金币交给位于安戈洛环形山沼泽地东南的莫维克。
text.description: 在你的悉心照料和喂养下，你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽长大得很快。它的乳齿很快就会被成年暴掠龙的牙齿取代了。如果你注意保留你的龙崽在成长过程中脱落的牙齿，那么你就能明确地判断它在何时成长到了可以被训练成坐骑的程度。$B$B你的毒皮暴掠龙会让你知道它需要什么。所以，你要密切注意它的一举一动。等到它的全部乳齿都已脱落的时候，就带着它和制作龙鞍的材料回来见我。我会帮你完成其馀的事情。
text.progress: 你有好好照顾那只迅猛龙吗？
text.completion: 看来你们一同成长，也没有害死对方。$B$B那么，事情都办妥了。我已经帮你把毒皮暴掠龙给训练好，它已经学会顺从你的哨音了。$B$B很少人能像你这么有毅力，愿意亲手饲养与照料一头毒皮暴掠龙，但你的努力非常值得。
text.completed: 去安戈洛环形山找沼泽地的莫维克。

english.title: They Grow Up So Fast
english.objectives: Return 20 Venomhide Baby Teeth,  the Venomhide Hatchling, 20 Runecloth, 20 Rugged Leather, and 80 gold to Mor'vek in the southeastern part of the Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: With your expert feeding and care, your venomhide hatchling will grow quickly. As they grow, their hatchling teeth will be replaced by adult teeth. If you keep the teeth shed by your hatchling as it grows, you'll have an easy way to tell when it's mature enough to be trained as a mount.$B$BYour venomhide will let you know what it needs, so pay close attention. When it has shed all of its baby teeth, return to me with your venomhide and the materials for your saddle and I'll do the rest.
english.progress: Have you been taking good care of that raptor?
english.completion: It looks like both of you have managed to do some growing without killing one another.$b$bThere, everything's finished. I've trained your venomhide ravasaur to respond when you blow this whistle.$b$bFew have the dedication to hand-feed and raise a venomhide, but they're well worth the effort.
english.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 好龙配好鞍
text.objectives: 给位于安戈洛环形山沼泽地东南的莫维克带去20块硬甲皮、20张符文布和80金币。
text.description: 你的毒皮暴掠龙强壮而又健康。看来你的确是有了一个好战友。等我给你做好了鞍子和缰绳，你就要准备骑上它了。就像你一样，这些骑乘用具必须进行特殊加工，好让它们能够承受毒皮暴掠龙所产生的剧毒。$B$B你要给我拿来一些硬甲皮，符文布，以及一些用来购买其它必需物品的资金。这样我立刻就能给你作出毒皮暴掠龙鞍了。
text.progress: 你把需要的材料都带来了吗？
text.completion: 大功告成。我已经让你的毒皮暴掠龙训练到能响应你的哨音。$B$B很少人能有足够的毅力亲手喂养一只毒皮暴掠龙，但他们的努力是值得的。
text.completed: 去安戈洛环形山找沼泽地的莫维克。

english.title: Gearing Up To Ride
english.objectives: Bring 20 Rugged Leather, 20 Runecloth, and 80 gold to Mor'vek in the southeast part of the Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: Your venomhide is strong and healthy and you've developed quite a bond. You'll be ready to ride him once I've completed your saddle and bridle. Just like you, they have to be specially conditioned to stand up to the toxins the raptor produces.$B$BAll you'll need to do is bring me some rugged leather, runecloth, and money to buy the rest of the supplies and I'll have that saddle for you in no time.
english.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 炎鹏的羽毛
text.objectives: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你给它弄来5根炎鹏的羽毛。
text.description: 这只幼崽一直在看着你，仿佛正在考虑你是否能明白它的意思。它在土地上用爪子画出两根羽毛的图案，然后又指了指绑在它臂肘和膝盖上的东西。$B$B它看上去并不饿，那么它要羽毛干什么？$B$B它一定是想用羽毛做装饰，就像你在其它暴掠龙身上见到过的那样。炎鹏身上的羽毛是所有羽毛之中最大的。这种猛禽生活在塔纳利斯西部，灌木谷的东北方。它们总喜欢聚集在巨大野兽的尸骨周围。
text.progress: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽期待地看着你。
text.completion: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽收下这些羽毛，开始打量着它们，并且把羽毛装饰在它的臂环上。
text.completed: 去找毒皮暴掠幼龙。

english.title: Searing Roc Feathers
english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to get 5 pieces of Searing Roc Plumage.
english.description: The hatchling looks at you for a moment, almost as if wondering whether you'll understand. It scrawls a picture of a pair of feathers in the dirt, then points with one claw to the bindings at its elbows and knees.$B$BIt doesn't seem hungry, but what could the feathers be for?$B$BIt must want them for adornments like the ones you've seen on other raptors. The largest feathers come from the searing rocs that congregate around the bones of large creatures in western Tanaris, northeast of Thistleshrub Valley.
english.progress: Your venomhide hatchling looks at you with anticipation.
english.completion: The venomhide hatchling accepts the feathers and begins looking them over, holding several up to its armbands.
english.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.

text.title: 饥饿的小龙
text.objectives: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你喂它15片鲜嫩的恐龙肉。
text.description: 这只毒皮暴掠龙幼崽用期待的眼神看着你，然后又在土地上画出了一些图案。$B$B这些图案都很粗糙，不过你还是能依稀从里面看出双帆龙，剑龙和翼手龙的形象。这只龙崽画完之后，又向你抬起了头，还露出了牙齿，做了一个咬的动作。$B$B你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽一定是想要吃这些恐龙的肉了。你要在安戈洛环形山找到并猎杀这些双帆龙、剑龙和翼手龙，取得恐龙肉，喂饱你饥饿的龙崽。
text.progress: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽舔了舔嘴唇并将头偏向一边。
text.completion: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽似乎很满足你提供的大餐，但不知道何时它又会饿。
text.completed: 去找毒皮暴掠幼龙。
text.objective1: 喂毒皮暴掠龙幼崽吃鲜嫩的恐龙肉。

english.title: Hungry, Hungry Hatchling
english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 15 pieces of Fresh Dinosaur Meat.
english.description: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe drawings are rough, but you can make out the shapes of diemetradons, stegodons, and pterrordaxes. As the raptor finishes the sketch, it looks up at you, bares its teeth, and makes a biting motion.$B$BYour venomhide hatchling must be craving fresh meat from these animals. Find and kill any type of diematradon, stegodon, or pterrordax in Un'Goro Crater and feed its meat to your hungry hatchling.
english.progress: The venomhide hatchling licks its lips and tilts its head to the side.
english.completion: The venomhide hatchling seems satisfied with the giant meal you've provided, but there's no way of telling when it will be hungry again.
english.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
english.objective1: Fresh Dinosaur Meat fed to Venomhide Hatchling

text.title: 水煮、爆炒还是生吃？
text.objectives: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你喂它12枚异种蝎卵。
text.description: 这只毒皮暴掠龙崽的肚皮发出“咕咕”的响声。它挥舞胳膊，引起了你的注意。然后它在土地上画出一些异种蝎，又在蝎子下面画了一些小的椭圆形。$B$B那一定是异种蝎的卵。你可以到位于塔纳利斯西部，靠近安戈洛环形山边界的腐化之巢去。那里可是一个收集异种蝎卵的好地方。
text.progress: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽看着你。
text.completion: 在吞完异种虫蛋大餐后，你的暴掠龙幼崽舔了舔它的嘴唇。有一瞬间，你觉得它似乎对已经结束的用餐时间感到失望。
text.completed: 去找毒皮暴掠幼龙。
text.objective1: 喂毒皮暴掠龙幼崽吃异种蝎卵。

english.title: Poached, Scrambled, Or Raw?
english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 12 Silithid Eggs.
english.description: The venomhide hatchling's stomach growls as it gestures to get your attention. It begins scratching pictures of silithids into the dirt, adding small ovals underneath them. It looks at you hopefully and gestures at the circles.$B$BThey can only mean silithid eggs. The Noxious Lair, in western Tanaris and near the border with Un'Goro Crater, would probably be a great place to find the eggs your little hatchling wants.
english.completion: Your hatchling licks its lips after devouring the meal of silithid eggs. For a moment, you think it seems disappointed that feeding time has come to an end.
english.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
english.objective1: Silithid Eggs fed to Venomhide Hatchling

text.title: 格里什幼虫
text.objectives: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你喂它10块异种蝎肉。
text.description: 这只毒皮暴掠龙幼崽用期待的眼神看着你，然后又在土地上画出了一些图案。$B$B这些图案所表现的似乎是一些大型昆虫，一些格里什异种蝎。龙崽画完以后，就用前臂指指图画，凭空猛咬了一口，又舔舔嘴唇。$B$B它一定是想让你去位于安戈洛环形山南部中心处的巨痕谷，在那里收集一些异种蝎肉。得到异种蝎肉之后，就用它来喂养你饥饿的龙崽吧。
text.progress: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽歪着头看着你。
text.completion: 毒皮暴掠龙幼崽对着你露齿微笑并开始休憩打盹。
text.completed: 去找毒皮暴掠幼龙。
text.objective1: 喂毒皮暴掠龙幼崽吃异种蝎肉。

english.title: Gorishi Grub
english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 10 Silithid Meat.
english.description: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe hatchling's drawings seem to resemble various types of large insects, perhaps the gorishi silithids. The hatchling finishes his picture, then gestures at it with one short arm, snaps its jaws, and licks its lips.$B$BIt must want you to go to the Slithering Scar, in center of the southern part of Un'Goro Crater, and gather silithid meat. When you have the meat, feed it to your hungry hatchling.
english.progress: The hatchling cocks its head and looks at you.
english.completion: Your venomhide hatchling flashes you a toothy smile and then settles in for a nap.
english.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
english.objective1: Silithid Meat fed to Venomhide Hatchling

text.title: 神谕者孤儿鲁鲁
text.objectives: 同孤儿监护员艾蕊娅交谈，然后使用神谕者孤儿哨召唤你要在儿童周照顾的孤儿。
text.description: 孤儿们一直都很期待能有像你这样的朋友，$N。我非常高兴你能答应照顾他们其中的一个。$B$B带上这只哨子。有了它，你随时都能召唤受你照顾的孤儿。你不需要照顾他太久——大概也就是儿童周这段时间。$B$B好了，$N，请召唤你的孤儿吧。他一定会非常喜欢你的。你们一定会在诺森德各处渡过不少愉快的旅程。
text.progress: 你照顾我们？
text.completion: 你会让我们远离小小狗人吗？太好了。我们开始喜欢上你了。坏心的小小狗人抢走了所有我们心爱的玩具。
text.completed: 去找神谕者孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的神谕者孤儿哨。
text.objective1: 同孤儿监护员艾蕊娅交谈

english.title: Little Orphan Roo Of The Oracles
english.objectives: Speak to Orphan Matron Aria, then use the Oracle Orphan Whistle to call the orphan you will be taking care of during Children's Week.
english.description: The orphans have been looking forward to the opportunity to meet friends like you, $N. It's wonderful that you've agreed to take one into your care.$B$BTake this whistle.  With it, you will be able to call for the orphan you have agreed to sponsor.  It will only last for a limited time - not much longer than Children's Week itself, in fact.$B$BPlease, $N, call upon your orphan.  He will be excited to meet you and see the sights of Northrend with you.
english.progress: You taking care of us?
english.completion: You take us away from puppy-men hatchlings? Good. We like you already. Mean puppy-men hatchlings took all our favorite toys away.
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 狼獾人孤儿科科
text.objectives: 同孤儿监护员艾蕊娅交谈，然后使用狼獾人孤儿哨召唤你要在儿童周照顾的孤儿。
text.description: 孤儿们一直都很期待能有像你这样的朋友，$N。我非常高兴你能答应照顾他们其中的一个。$B$B带上这只哨子。有了它，你随时都能召唤受你照顾的孤儿。你不需要照顾他太久——大概也就是儿童周这段时间。$B$B好了，$N，请召唤你的孤儿吧。他一定会非常喜欢你的。你们一定会在诺森德各处渡过不少愉快的旅程。
text.progress: 孤儿监护员说科科跟你走。
text.completion: 你带科科去打猎？能够离开那个不让科科去打猎的坏心孤儿院老女士真是太好了。
text.completed: 去找狼獾人孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的狼獾人孤儿哨。
text.objective1: 同孤儿监护员艾蕊娅交谈

english.title: Little Orphan Kekek Of The Wolvar
english.objectives: Speak to Orphan Matron Aria, then use the Wolvar Orphan Whistle to call the orphan you will be taking care of during Children's Week.
english.description: The orphans have been looking forward to the opportunity to meet friends like you, $N. It's wonderful that you've agreed to take one into your care.$B$BTake this whistle.  With it, you will be able to call for the orphan you have agreed to sponsor.  It will only last for a limited time - not much longer than Children's Week itself, in fact.$B$BPlease, $N, call upon your orphan.  He will be excited to meet you and see the sights of Northrend with you.
english.progress: Orphan lady say Kekek go with you.
english.completion: You take Kekek hunting? Good to get away from mean old orphan lady who doesn't let Kekek hunt.
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 史上最巨大的树！
text.objectives: 带着你的孤儿鲁鲁转至灰喉堡。当你进入到那棵大树的树干里时，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 在大战爆发，我们离开自己的村庄之前，索乌塞和我们讲过历史上最巨大的树！$B$B索乌塞管那棵树叫灰喉堡。索乌塞告诉我们，它就在灰熊丘陵的中央。不，等等，这不是索乌塞说的。索乌塞说的是灰熊丘陵。肯定没错！那棵好大的树就在灰熊丘陵的中央。绝对没有错！$B$B你带我们去那里好不好？我们要好好看看那棵大树。索乌塞告诉我们，有许多大熊怪就住在那棵树里。也许我们还能看见他们呢。
text.progress: 我们可以看倒下的大树吗？可以吗？
text.completion: 我们从不知道树可以长那么大！从不。也许造物主对这树有特别的计划？
text.completed: 去找神谕者孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的神谕者孤儿哨。

english.title: The Biggest Tree Ever!
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Grizzlemaw. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you enter the trunk of the great tree.
english.description: Before there was a big war and we left the village, we remember Soo-say telling us all about the biggest tree ever!$B$BSoo-say call it Grizzlemaw or something. Soo-say tell us it in the middle Grizzle Hills. No, wait, that not what Soo-say say. Soo-say say Grizzly Hills. Now we remember! Tree is big and right in middle of Grizzly Hills. Can't miss!$B$BYou take us there, oki? We see inside of giant tree? Soo-say tell us big bear men live in tree too. Maybe we see them.
english.progress: Can we see the big tree? Can we?
english.completion: We never knew trees got that big! Nope. Maybe Great Ones had special plan for it?
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 熊怪的家园
text.objectives: 带着你的孤儿科科转至灰喉堡。当你进入那棵巨树的树干时，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克总是向我们讲强大武士的故事。其中有些故事发生在很远的地方。有时候，他会讲巨大的熊怪为了保卫树城而英勇战斗的故事。$B$B也许你能带科科到那里去，去看看那些大树，还有那里的战场！高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克告诉科科，那座巨大的树城灰喉堡就矗立在灰熊丘陵的正中心。$B$B科科在遇到监护员之前从没有见过一座城市。但这座城市里没有战士，只有穿着紫袍子的人。科科想去看看真正的战士为了真正的城市作战的样子！
text.progress: 科科想去参观倒下的世界之树。我们走吧。
text.completion: 这是科科心目中理想的城市。熊怪跟狂心者一样为了家园而奋战。孤儿院的女士告诉科科不要和其它小孩打架，但科科仍旧照打。
text.completed: 去找狼獾人孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的狼獾人孤儿哨。

english.title: Home Of The Bear-Men
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Grizzlemaw. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you enter the trunk of the great tree.
english.description: High Shaman Rakjak always tell stories of mighty warriors, even ones far away. Sometimes he tell stories about giant bear-men fighting great battle for tree-city.$B$BMaybe you take Kekek there, see tree, see battle! High Shaman Rakjak tell Kekek that giant tree-city Grizzlemaw stand in the middle of Grizzly Hills.$B$BKekek never see a city before meeting orphan lady, but this city have no warriors, only men in purple dresses. Kekek want to see real warriors fight for real city.
english.progress: Kekek want to visit bear-men tree. We go.
english.completion: This is Kekek's kind of city. Bear-men fight for home just like Frenzyheart do. Orphan lady tell Kekek not to fight with other pups, but Kekek fight anyway.
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 又一年，又一次纪念
text.objectives: 在美酒节营地背后的布利克斯·菲克维特处兑换礼品券。
text.description: 我们不仅供应美酒，还独家出售啤酒杯呢！瞧这些漂亮的杯子，非常具有纪念意义哦！这是一张礼品券。$B$B与美酒节营地背后的布利克斯谈一谈。他是个古怪的家伙，总是带着一副护目镜。他负责兑换礼品券，以及出售各类美酒。
text.progress: 怎么啦宝贝？有东西要给我？
text.completion: 这是什么？酒杯兑换券？你喜欢喝酒吗？太棒了！我把酒杯给你以后，你就可以喝个痛快了！然后再多喝几杯。也许接着再多来几杯……跟着，重点来了，再回来找我。$B$B听着，我知道迟早你一定会再回来找我的。假如你想要兑换美酒节奖品章的话，你就要回来找我。$B$B总而言之，这是你的酒杯，记得晚点再来和我谈谈。
text.completed: 去找杜隆塔尔的布利克斯·菲克维特。

english.title: Another Year, Another Souvenir.
english.objectives: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Blix Fixwidget in the back of the Brewfest camp.
english.description: Not only are we supplying brew to everyone, we also have steins to give out!  Beautiful, commemorative steins all obtained by the most legal of means!  Here's a voucher for one.$b$bTalk to Blix near the back of the Brewfest camp.  He's pretty strange, even more so now that he's always wearing those goggles.  He'll handle the voucher for you, and any other Brewfest transaction.
english.progress: What's happening hot stuff? Got something for me?
english.completion: What's this? A stein voucher? So you like drinking? Great! After I give you this stein, go have a few drinks! Then a few more. Maybe have a few more after that... Then, now this is important, come see me.$b$bLook, I know you'll be back eventually. If you want your Brewfest tokens redeemed you have to see me.$b$bAnyways, here's the stein, and remember to talk to me later.
english.completed: Return to Blix Fixwidget in Durotar.

text.title: 又是一年美酒飘香时。
text.objectives: 在美酒节营地的贝尔比处兑换礼品券。
text.description: 美酒节除了赛羊会外，还有一项传统，那就是饮酒狂欢！如果你有时间的话，就将这张礼品券交给贝尔比吧。她就在美酒节营地的后面。要是你看不见她，没关系，她一定会看见你的。$B$B无论如何，将礼品券交给她，你就能免费领到一只美酒节酒杯。她还出售各种美酒哦。
text.progress: 怎么啦宝贝？有东西要给我？
text.completion: 噢，只是张酒杯兑换券……说不定你还花了一番力气才弄来。好吧，这是你今年的酒杯。$B$B不过我猜我应该还会常常再看到你。无论如何，要是想兑换美酒节奖章，你找我就对了……$B$B或他找我……$B$B噢噢喔……或是他……
text.completed: 去找丹莫罗的贝尔比。

english.title: Another Year, Another Souvenir.
english.objectives: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Belbi Quikswitch in the Brewfest camp.
english.description: Brewfest isn't just about racing rams, it's also about drinking!  When you have a moment, take this voucher to Belbi Quikswitch.  She's near the back of the Brewfest camp.  If you can't see her, don't worry, she'll be sure to see you.$b$bIn any case, take this voucher to her to get your free Brewfest stein.  She'll also be more than happy to handle any and all other Brewfest transactions.
english.progress: What's happening hot stuff? Got something for me?
english.completion: Aww, it's just a stein voucher... Maybe you're just playing hard to get. So here's this year's stein for you.$b$bBut I suspect I'll be seeing a lot more of you. After all, if you want any Brewfest tokens redeemed, I'm your girl...$b$bOr maybe I'm his girl...$b$bOooohhh... or his...
english.completed: Return to Belbi Quikswitch in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 青铜巨龙圣地
text.objectives: 带上你的孤儿鲁鲁转至青铜巨龙圣地。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 有时候，高阶神谕者索乌塞会讲一些关于一座巨龙祭坛的故事。那和雨水巨石可不一样。索乌塞告诉我们，也许我们能在那里看到我们自己，只不过不会像我们现在这样闪光光。索乌塞的意思是说，我们能在那里看到自己许多年以后的样子。$B$B你要带我们去那里？我们记得青铜巨龙圣地是在一个叫龙骨荒野的地方。索乌塞说，雨水巨石让他知道，那个圣地就在龙眠神殿的东北方，或者是暮冬要塞的西北方。我们现在出发吗？
text.progress: 我们要去参观青铜巨龙圣地吗？
text.completion: 我很开心你能带我们来这里，$N。我们一直很担心如果孤儿监护员发现我们在索拉查会怎么样。
text.end: 带着鲁鲁转至青铜巨龙圣地
text.completed: 去找神谕者孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的神谕者孤儿哨。

english.title: The Bronze Dragonshrine
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit the Bronze Dragonshrine. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: Sometimes High-Oracle Soo-say tell stories about a shrine to dragon-things, not like great rain stone, but different. Soo-say tell us maybe we see ourselves there, but not like in a shiny. Soo-say mean we could see what we are like many years from now.$B$BYou take us there? We remember shrine to bronze dragon-things in place called Dragonblight. Soo-say say great rain stone show him shrine to northeast of Wyrmrest Temple, or northwest of place dryskins call Wintergarde Keep. We go?
english.progress: We visit shrine to dragon-things?
english.completion: We very glad you brought us here, $N. We always worried what would happen to us when the orphan matron found us in Sholazar.
english.end: Roo taken to visit Bronze Dragonshrine
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 青铜巨龙圣地
text.objectives: 带上你的孤儿科科转至青铜巨龙圣地。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 当科科还是小孩子的时候，他经常会听长者们说起一个遥远的圣地。有时候，长者们会说，在青铜巨龙圣地能知道关于未来的一切事情。$B$B科科要告诉你，他要成为强大的战士。所以我们现在就要到那里去看看。青铜巨龙圣地就在龙骨荒野，在一个被称作龙眠神殿的东北方，一座被称为暮冬要塞的人类城镇的西北方。$B$B我们要到那里去，看看未来。我要让监护员知道，她是错的。科科是战士，不是傻瓜。
text.progress: 科科想去参观龙眠圣殿。
text.completion: 我说得没错吧？“科科告诉过你了。”这句话科科永远说不烦。$B$B也许你会开始相信科科说过的事，像是天空是多么的绿。
text.end: 带着科科转至青铜巨龙圣地
text.completed: 去找狼獾人孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的狼獾人孤儿哨。

english.title: The Bronze Dragonshrine
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit the Bronze Dragonshrine. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: When Kekek was a pup, he sometimes heard elders talking about a far-off shrine. Sometimes they say that bronze dragon-things there know all about future.$B$BKekek tell you he be great warrior, now we go see. Bronze dragon-thing shrine somewhere in Dragonblight, northeast of dragon-thing temple called Wyrmrest, also northwest of man-town called Wintergarde.$B$BWe go there, see future. Prove orphan-lady wrong about Kekek. Kekek warrior, not bully.
english.progress: Kekek want to visit dragonshrine.
english.completion: See? Kekek never get tired of saying, "Kekek tell you so."$b$bMaybe now you believe other things Kekek tell you, like how sky is green.
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 转至奇妙玩具店的旅行
text.objectives: 在奇妙玩具店购买一只规模纸飞艇，然后把它掷给你的孤儿鲁鲁。
text.description: 我们还有时间去下一站？我们听说达拉然有一间玩具店，但我们从来没有去过那里。监护员说，如果大家都要去那里的话，那里就会被挤爆了。也许我们可以去那里？只有我们？我们可以在那里得到一只规模纸飞艇吗？他们就会把那种小飞艇送到达拉然的奇妙玩具店去。我们一直都想要一只那样的小飞艇。也许你能给我们一只？
text.progress: 我们会去奇妙玩具店吗？
text.completion: 真有趣！我们喜欢玩具店。也许孤儿监护员改天能带我们去。我们会拜托她的。或许你也能跟她说一声？
text.completed: 去找神谕者孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的神谕者孤儿哨。
text.objective1: 将小型纸飞艇掷给鲁鲁

english.title: A Trip To The Wonderworks
english.objectives: Purchase a Small Paper Zeppelin at the Wonderworks and then throw it to your orphan, Roo.
english.description: We have time for one more stop? We heard Dalaran has toy store, but we never get to go there. Orphan mistress says too many orphans would crowd the store. Maybe we can go, just us?$B$BWe can have a small paper zeppelin? We think they have those at Wonderworks in Dalaran. We always wanted to play with one. Maybe you throw one to us?
english.progress: We go to the Wonderworks?
english.completion: That was fun! We like toy store. Maybe orphan matron take us sometimes. We ask. Maybe you tell her too?
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.
english.objective1: Throw Small Paper Zeppelin to Roo

text.title: 转至奇妙玩具店的旅行
text.objectives: 在奇妙玩具店购买一只规模纸飞艇，再将小飞艇丢给你的孤儿科科。
text.description: 你还要带科科去另一个地方？监护员说达拉然有一个奇妙玩具店。但科科从没有去过那里。保姆说，如果有一个孤儿去了，她就必须带所有孤儿都去那里了。你能带科科去那里吗？$B$B科科看到过其它孩子玩折纸飞艇。科科听说那些飞艇都是从奇妙玩具店里飞出来的。也许你能在那里弄到一只折纸飞艇，然后和科科一起玩？
text.progress: 到玩具店了吗？
text.completion: 科科喜欢玩纸飞艇。虽然没有像打猎一样好玩，但至少让我在孤儿院无聊时有事可做。
text.completed: 去找狼獾人孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的狼獾人孤儿哨。
text.objective1: 将小型纸飞艇掷给科科

english.title: A Visit To The Wonderworks
english.objectives: Purchase a Small Paper Zeppelin at the Wonderworks and then throw it to your orphan, Kekek.
english.description: You take Kekek one more place? Orphan lady say Dalaran have toy store called Wonderworks, but Kekek never seen it. She say that if one orphan go, she have to take everyone. Maybe you take Kekek?$B$BKekek seen other children playing with small paper zeppelin? Kekek hear those come from Wonderworks. Maybe you get one and throw it around with Kekek?
english.progress: This toy store yet?
english.completion: Kekek like playing with paper zeppelin. Not as good as hunting, but give something to do when bored at orphanage.
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.
english.objective1: Throw Small Paper Zeppelin to Kekek

text.title: 伙伴！
text.objectives: 带领你的孤儿鲁鲁前去拜访冬鳞避难所。当你到达那里的时候，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 你要知道，孤儿们都是很孤独的。有时候，我们很想去别的地方看看，结交一些新的朋友。$B$B也许你能带我们去闯一闯？我们听说有一个叫冬鳞避难所的地方。那就在北风苔原里面。要去那里，我们应该向西北方前进，走到靠近考达拉岛边缘的地方。$B$B监护员说有一个勇敢的人也在那里养育着一群孤儿。他们一定也很孤单，一定也需要朋友。你愿意带我们去那里吗？
text.progress: 你要带我们去冬鳞避难所？也许还能认识新朋友？
text.completion: 那真好玩！我们下次再来？我等不及要再次看到我们的新朋友了！
text.end: 带领鲁鲁参观冬鳞避难所。
text.completed: 去找神谕者孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的神谕者孤儿哨。

english.title: Playmates!
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Winterfin Retreat. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: Orphanage gets real lonely, you know? Sometimes we want to go places, meet new friends.$B$BMaybe you can take us somewheres with other hatchlings? We heard about a place called Winterfin Retreat, in the big Borean Tundra. We think it's way in the northwest, near the edge of the Coldarra-island.$B$BThe orphan lady say someone brave save a bunch of hatchlings there. We think they lonely, too. We think they need friends. You take us there?
english.progress: You take us to Winterfin Retreat? Meet new friends maybe?
english.completion: That was fun! We go again sometime? We can't wait to see our new friend again!
english.end: Roo taken to visit Winterfin Retreat
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 伙伴！
text.objectives: 带着你的孤儿科科转至飘雪林地。当你到达那里的时候，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 除了监护员照顾的小孩子，科科还想有别的朋友。也许我们能去一些别的地方？$B$B科科知道有一个部落居住在龙骨荒野。他们住的地方叫做飘雪林地。你知道吗？飘雪林地在莫亚基港口的北边和红玉巨龙圣地的南边。$B$B<提到海象人的时候，科科的脸上现出一副生气的表情。>$B$B你带科科去那里。去拜访那里的村子。也许我们能遇到新的狼獾人，让他们知道，狂心氏族有多厉害！
text.progress: 你现在能带科科去飘雪林地？
text.completion: 科科喜欢飘雪林地的新朋友，或许下次有机会一起打猎。说不定我们能在海象人睡觉的时候把他们翻得肚子朝天。
text.end: 带领科科参观飘雪林地。
text.completed: 去找狼獾人孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的狼獾人孤儿哨。

english.title: Playmates!
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Snowfall Glade. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: Kekek think there not enough other pups living with orphan-lady. Maybe we go visit some others?$B$BKekek know a tribe that lives in Dragonblight, at place called Snowfall Glade. You know? Snowfall Glade north of walrus-men town of Mo'aki Harbor and south of Ruby Dragonshrine.$B$B<Kekek scowls at the mention of the tuskarr.>$B$BYou take Kekek there, to some of the villages there. Maybe we meet new wolvar, show them how fierce Frenzyheart are!
english.progress: You take Kekek to Snowfall Glade now?
english.completion: Kekek like new Snowfall friends, maybe come back and go hunting together sometime. Maybe we go tip over walrus-men when they sleeping.
english.end: Kekek taken to visit Snowfall Glade
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 死者的感激
text.objectives: 弄到悼念糕饼，并把它交给暴风城墓地的欢快的人类灵魂。$B$B你必须使用一朵橙菊，才能看到那个隐形的灵魂。
text.description: 真高兴能再次见到朋友和亲人，不过也许我做得有些太夸张了……我已经吃光了他们为我准备的一切！$B$B能不能帮我一个忙，再给我拿来一些那种美味的悼念糕饼？我会非常感激你的……$B$B我想，那边的查普曼正在出售食谱。
text.progress: 你有悼念糕饼吗？
text.completion: 喔，更多美味的悼念糕饼，感谢你！$B$B请收下这个当作回报……一点节日的小娱乐。
text.completed: 去找艾尔文森林的欢快的人类灵魂。

english.title: The Grateful Dead
english.objectives: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Human Spirit in Stormwind's graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.
english.description: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.
english.progress: You don't have any Bread of the Dead, do you?
english.completion: Ah, more delicious Bread of the Dead, thank you!$B$BPlease, take this in return... a little something fun for the holiday.
english.completed: Return to Cheerful Human Spirit in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 红龙女王
text.objectives: 带上你的孤儿鲁鲁去拜访阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者，她就在龙眠神殿的顶端。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 高阶神谕者索乌塞有一个故事，说的是造物主造出了所有的龙和一位统驭所有巨龙的女王。我们想看一看那位女王！你能带我们去龙眠神殿的最高处吗？索乌塞告诉我过我们，那个神庙就在龙骨荒野的中心。$B$B我们真的很想见到红龙女王。她一定又大又美丽。也许她能帮助我们找到新的爸爸妈妈。$B$B你会带我们去吗？
text.progress: 我们要去看红龙女王了吗？
text.completion: 你觉得她之前看过神谕者吗？我们可能是第一个见过红龙女王的神谕者耶！我们觉得她喜欢我们，不过不太确定。她没有讲太多话。不过，这真好玩！
text.end: 带着鲁鲁去见阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者
text.completed: 去找神谕者孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的神谕者孤儿哨。

english.title: The Dragon Queen
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at the top of Wyrmrest Temple. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: One of High-Oracle Soo-say's stories says Great Ones made all the dragons and a queen for the dragons, too. We want to see her! Would you take us to the top of Wyrmrest Temple? We remember Soo-say telling us the temple-thing was in the middle of Dragonblight.$B$BWe really want to meet dragon queen. She must be so big and pretty. Maybe she help us find new parents.$B$BYou take us?
english.completion: Do you think she ever saw an oracle before? We might be the first one ever to meet her! We thinks she liked us, but we're not sure. She doesn't talk a lot. Nope. But that was fun!
english.end: Roo taken to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 红龙女王
text.objectives: 带上你的孤儿科科去拜访阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者，她就在龙眠神殿的顶端。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 科科一直都很喜欢巨龙。科科一直都想有一条龙。但监护员不让科科这样做。不过她说了，你可以带科科去看看红龙女王。$B$B科科终于听监护员说了一句也有道理的话。你愿意带科科去龙骨荒野中心的龙眠神殿吗？我们一同飞到那座神庙顶上，去看看红龙女王。她一定非常非常巨大。这样她才能成为所有巨龙的女王。科科已经等不及想要见她了！
text.progress: 我们要去看红龙女王了吗？
text.completion: 红龙女王长的跟科科想的不一样，但科科知道原因。如果她一直变成大龙，那会把访客压个稀巴烂！总有一天我要看看她的庐山真面目。
text.end: 带着科科去见阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者
text.completed: 去找狼獾人孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的狼獾人孤儿哨。

english.title: The Dragon Queen
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at the top of Wyrmrest Temple. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: Kekek always liked dragons. Always wanted to be one, but orphan-lady said no. But she did say maybe you take Kekek to meet dragon queen.$B$BKekek think orphan-lady have good idea for once. You take Kekek to Wyrmrest Temple in the middle of Dragonblight? Fly all the way to top to meet dragon queen. She must be really big, to be queen of all dragons. Kekek can't wait to see!
english.progress: We go see dragon queen now?
english.completion: Queen not what Kekek expected, but Kekek understand why. Queen's visitors get crushed if she was always big dragon! Still want to see someday.
english.end: Kekek taken to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 拜访一位造物主
text.objectives: 带着你的孤儿鲁鲁转至塑造者之台的源生石像那里。当你到达那里的时候，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 高阶神谕者索乌塞总是告诉我们，造物主如何建起圣地，而我们则让它们发光。但他从没有见过一位造物主。没有人见过造物主。不过，也许你能找到一位造物主？$B$B索乌塞告诉我们，造物主建造了一座界门，并把它安放在索拉查南部的正中心。索乌塞没有说它会通向哪里。但也许我们能借助它走到一位造物主的面前！带我们走进那道界门，让我们看看门的另一边到底有些什么吧，$N。
text.progress: 你知道如何找到一位造物主吗？我们以前从来没看过造物主。
text.completion: 我们见到了一位造物主！可惜是在他的午睡时间，但我们了解。我们也喜欢打瞌睡！也许我们是跟造物主学到了如何打瞌睡，就像我们学到了圣坛及亮晶晶！$B$B我们可以在他醒来时再来拜访他吗？
text.end: 带鲁鲁去拜访源生石像
text.completed: 去找神谕者孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的神谕者孤儿哨。

english.title: Meeting a Great One
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit the Etymidian at the Shaper's Terrace. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: High-Oracle Soo-say always tell us about how Great Ones built shrines and we give them shinies, but he never see Great Ones. No one see Great Ones, but maybe you know how to find one?$B$BSoo-say told us the Great Ones made a waygate and put it in the center of the southern part of Sholazar. Soo-say not say where it goes, but maybe it take us to a Great One! Take us through that waygate and let's find out, $N.
english.progress: Do you know how to find a Great One? We've never seen one before.
english.completion: We got to meet a Great One! Too bad it was during his nap time, but we understand. We like naps, too! Maybe we learn naps from Great Ones like we learn about shrines and shinies!$b$bCan we come back and visit the Great One again when not sleeping?
english.end: Roo taken to visit The Etymidian
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 强大的赫米特·奈辛瓦里
text.objectives: 带着你的孤儿科科去拜访赫米特·奈辛瓦里。他就在奈辛瓦里营地。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 你知道科科一直想要见到的人是谁吗？赫米特·奈辛瓦里。$B$B也许你能带科科去见他？长者哈尔卡克把他的所有事情都告诉我们了。他来到索拉查就是为了猎捕当地最大的怪物！就连狂心氏族的长老们也尊敬赫米特·奈辛瓦里，称他为伟大的猎人。$B$B长者哈尔卡克告诉科科，奈辛瓦里营地就在索拉查西侧的中部，碎浪河附近。我们去那里拜访他，学习如何像赫米特那样狩猎好不好？
text.progress: 我都等不及与赫米特·奈辛瓦里见面了。
text.completion: 你能帮科科读他那本书吗？然后科科要跟赫米特·奈辛瓦里一起打猎！
text.end: 带科科去拜访赫米特·奈辛瓦里
text.completed: 去找狼獾人孤儿。如果你的孤儿不在附近那么请使用你的狼獾人孤儿哨。

english.title: The Mighty Hemet Nesingwary
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Base Camp. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: Know who Kekek always wanted to meet? Hemet Nesingwary.$B$BMaybe you take Kekek to see him? Elder Harkek tell us all about him. He come to Sholazar to hunt biggest creatures anywhere! Even Frenzyheart elders respect Hemet Nesingwary as great hunter.$B$BElder Harkek tell Kekek that Nesingwary Base Camp in the middle of west side of Sholazar, right on river called Seabreach Flow. We go visit and learn how to hunt like Hemet?
english.completion: You help Kekek learn him a book? Then, Kekek hunt with Hemet Nesingwary!
english.end: Kekek taken to visit Hemet Nesingwary
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 返回孤儿院
text.objectives: 将你的监护对象送回到达拉然孤儿院，把神谕者孤儿哨交给达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。
text.description: 我们和你一起渡过了一段最美好的时光$N。真希望你会是我们的$g爸爸:妈妈。但你现在必须带我回达拉然的孤儿院里。$B$B也许你什么时候能再来看我们？我们喜欢去看冬鳞小鱼人和红龙女王。绝不会有人相信，我们竟然见到了造物主！$B$B我们会想念你的，$N。一定要给我们写信，我们也会给你写信的，好吗？
text.progress: 我们一定得回去吗？我们想要留在你身边。
text.completion: 听起来小鲁鲁过了一周的快乐时光。他在孤儿院时是极度的孤单并渴望交到一些新朋友。非常感谢你愿意看顾他。
text.completed: 去找达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。

english.title: Back To The Orphanage
english.objectives: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Oracle Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
english.description: We had the best time with you, $N. We wish you could be our $g daddy : mama; now, but you have to take us back to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.$B$BMaybe you could come visit us again sometime? We loved meeting Winterfin hatchlings and getting to see the dragon queen. No one will believe us when we say we met a Great One!$B$BWe going to miss you, $N. We promise to write letter sometime, oki?
english.progress: Do we have to go back? We want to stay with you.
english.completion: It sounds like little Roo had a great time this week. I know he was getting awfully lonely in the orphanage and was eager to make some new friends. Thank you so much for agreeing to look after him.
english.completed: Return to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

text.title: 返回孤儿院
text.objectives: 将你的监护对象送回到达拉然孤儿院，把狼獾人孤儿哨交给达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。
text.description: 你知道吗？你不是个坏人，$N。你带着科科去了许多有趣的地方。科科遇到了不少新朋友，还经历了一些其它孩子根本想象不到的事情。$B$B你与赫米特·奈辛瓦里和飘雪林地的小孩全都成了科科最好的朋友。也许你能把那本绿色山丘书带给科科？科科答应了要不时给你写一些东西，让你知道他的情况。也许，作为一个大舌头怪的孩子也是有些好处的。$B$B科科现在要回到孤儿监护员艾蕊娅那里去了，要回到紫色人的城市去了。
text.progress: 科科不想走。科科想和$N去看看更多诺森德的事物。
text.completion: 感谢你这周愿意照顾科科。我知道他很麻烦，但我认为多一点的个别照料及多一点朋友，他会改善很多。无疑的，他这几周内会一直念着那些和你一起经历的冒险故事。
text.completed: 去找达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。

english.title: Back To The Orphanage
english.objectives: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Wolvar Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
english.description: Know what? You not so bad after all, $N. You take Kekek a lot of fun places. Kekek meet a lot of new friends and do things no other pup get to do.$B$BYou, and Hemet Nesingwary, and Snowfall Glade pups all new best friends. Maybe sometime you bring Kekek that green hills book? Kekek promise to write sometimes, too, tell you how things go. Maybe even be nice to big-tongue kids sometimes.$B$BKekek gotta go back to orphan-lady Aria now, back in purple human city.
english.progress: Kekek not want to go. Kekek want to see more of Northrend with Jeursey.
english.completion: Thank you for agreeing to care for Kekek this week. I know he can be a handful, but I think that with more individual attention and a few more friends, he'll do a lot better. No doubt he's going to be telling stories of his adventures with you for weeks.
english.completed: Return to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

text.title: 冬幕节礼物
text.completion: 礼物上有一个小牌子写着：$B$B冬幕节快乐，$N！

text.title: 受伤的同伴
text.objectives: 将破旧的部族护盾交给奥伯妮·亮鬃。她就在雷霆崖里的长者高地。
text.description: $c，相信你已经知道，这里的战斗相当艰苦。我们还能守住战线，但我们的战士已死伤惨重。$b$b我们的一个名叫奥伯妮·亮鬃的战士手臂上的伤口感染了。她被送回到雷霆崖进行急救。不过，她在混乱中把盾牌遗失在了这里。你能把这面盾牌连同我们的祝福一起给她带过去么？我们非常想念她的微笑。$b$b你可以在雷霆崖的长者高地那里找到她。
text.progress: 喔！你好。我想我应该没看过你；有什么可以为你效劳的吗？
text.completion: 喔，我的盾！我想我暂时没办法用它了，但还是谢谢你。我讨厌只能没用的坐在这里而不能去前线出力，但我这条手臂就算上战场也帮不了任何人。$B$B请自己多保重。
text.completed: 去找莫高雷的奥伯妮·亮鬃。

english.title: An Injured Colleague
english.objectives: Take the Battered Tribal Shield to Aponi Brightmane on Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff.
english.description: The fight's been hard up here, $c, as I'm sure you know. We're holding out, but not everyone has gone unscathed.$b$bA warrior in our band, Aponi Brightmane, was taken ill by an infected wound in her arm. She's been taken back to Thunder Bluff for recuperation. It seems she left her shield here at the front in the confusion, however - could you take it to her, along with our well-wishes? Her smile is missed around here.$b$bYou can find her on Elder Rise on the Bluff.
english.progress: Oh! Hello there. I don't think we've met; is there something I can do for you?
english.completion: Oh, my shield! I won't be using it anytime soon, but thank you. I hate that I'm sitting here useless when I could be helping on the front, but fighting with my arm like this won't help anyone.$b$bTake care out there, won't you?
english.completed: Return to Aponi Brightmane in Mulgore.

text.title: 如果在我战斗的时候，你读到了这个……
text.objectives: ELM Daze Target 要求你为了丹及伟大的正义杀掉5个ELM攻击者！
text.description: Dan是全世界最可怕的程序员……我说的是魔兽世界！$B$B当我战斗的时候，你却没办法和我说话，难道这不是很奇怪的事情吗？而现在这种怪事已经不会再发生了，我的朋友。Dan对我的一个生物特性做了大规模改进！$B$B和我一起庆祝吧，消灭这些可怕的怪物。正是它们让我陷入了永远不能停息的战斗之中。
text.progress: 什么？！$B$B你竟敢在还没完成那个简单到不行的工作之前回来跟我讲话！要求你去杀死五只下贱的狗头人很难吗？$B$B我真想踩扁你，你这只渺小的虫子！$B$B现在，在我忘记我们还在进行交谈程序前给我回去做你的杀戮工作！更狠的说法是，在丹找出你数据库中的角色记录并删除前！
text.completion: 你做到了！我知道你行的！$B$B丹就是这么的神奇？！你不只可以在我处于战斗中时跟我聊天或接受任务，更可以看到任务完成对话窗以让你可以按下底下的“完成”按钮并获得你该有的奖励。$B$B喔耶！
